mls_001: You can recognise it by its wide, level canopy, trained flat over a wooden frame, standing as a pair of two different limes. It stands before the gate of the fortified church in Berndshausen.
mls_002: You can recognise it as the group of three limes trained and pruned together, hollowed by age. It stands before the fortified church in Dagobertshausen.
mls_003: You can recognise it by the bench built inside its hollow trunk, its branches trained in three tiers over an octagonal wooden frame. It stands at An der Linde, on the corner of Schulberg, in Hilgershausen.
mls_004: You can recognise it as the thickest but shortest of the four, its hollow trunk cropped back to just five metres tall. It stands on the sandstone common before the church in Ostheim.
